counterfactuals.change: Hold q-355546 ODE, h=1 and initial x=2 fixed; change initial y from 6 to 7 in an independent review fixture.
counterfactuals.expected: Constant must change from 7 to 8; each key accepted on its own IVP and rejected on the other. Prompt and solution must track IC.
counterfactuals.observed: Exact ODE/IC checks pass, native grader accepts both correct keys and rejects cross answers, and actual UI renders both changed IC/solutions. Generator accepts only h and rejects y0, demonstrating unavailable eligible variation.
counterfactuals.justification: Lesson tutorial 974 says to substitute the initial condition to solve the constant; initial y is mathematically answer-bearing. Pair validates the dependency, not generator coverage.

counterfactuals.change: Change Find to Determine on the same blank IVP; reverse all radio options while preserving UUIDs and correct key.
counterfactuals.expected: Same mathematical answer and learner grading; only displayed order may change.
counterfactuals.observed: Native blank key/wrong-entry outcomes remain correct; all five options retain correctness before/after permutation. Rendered wording and bank are readable.
counterfactuals.justification: Prose verb and source option order do not enter the ODE or initial condition. Actual UI shuffles positions by identity.

shortcut_probes.subgroup: q-104065 sine/cosine ODE family, all nonzero shifts
shortcut_probes.strategy: Select the unique log option containing no pi, ignoring ODE integration and initial data.
shortcut_probes.conclusion: 8/8 versus uniform random 1/5. Correctness depends on a fixed C=0 assignment; pi is a distractor-only standalone constant in the alternative logarithm. This is an incidental bank cue rather than the required calculus.
